purpose: Intent-aware visual product identification and precise live availability/price workflow with targeted retake guidance and V22.1 stability preserved.
verified_regression: V6 through V22.2 PASS via npm test
live_truth_policy: Current Odoo price and availability are authoritative; archived price/stock are not used as current truth.
visual_identity_policy: Live commerce claims require sufficient product identity; otherwise request exact product-name/SKU/barcode evidence.
pesticide_dosage_policy: Clear readable label text or verified product data only; unclear visual dosage claims are blocked.
